source_comparisons.comparison: Source A exposes GL/JP/shared visual identity and animation metadata but no structured skills, passives, TMR/STMR, leader skills, categories, banners, rates, events, story or dialogue.
Source B supplies structured 2018 records but no vision cards, NV/NV+/EX, Brave Shift, Overdrive, leader skills/categories or visual assets.
aEnigmatic revisions are later than Source B and include vision cards, but declare no extraction method or original game revision; MIT metadata is not a content waiver.
TBMonkey targets GL v9.0.0 with battle/mission/event tables and a contract; ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS.md reserves game content rights to Square Enix and gumi.
Elvlin mixes original-client references, recovered layers and explicitly authored overlay; no APK or pack was downloaded.
Fandom and Altema provide article-level categories and JP final-era topics, not bulk verified data; rights notices and proxy access limit reuse.
